title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
source: Souree Info: Master Soundboard Reels > PCM > PCM (14-bit) (Sony L-750ESX-HFB tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16; this source is a fix of the two previous flawed sources circulated by Scott Clugston; there is another Fixed version of this source in circulation

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with a superb upgraded mix; performance details unavailable
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the high‑quality soundboard source and the meticulous upgrade work by Tim Dalton, Scott Clugston, and Charlie Miller, describing the mix as superb. No specific comments on the musical performance are provided, so the show’s quality cannot be assessed.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single 5‑star review focuses on the recording mix; lacking any performance commentary, rating reflects strong technical praise but limited overall data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Superb upgrade of existing sources; clean, clear mix praised by reviewer
